specs.title: fresh conversation clears the plan, proposals, draft and continuation without deleting audit state
fresh conversation cancels a pending initial turn and rejects its late completion
reload restores only an owned plan and clearly says previous chat was not restored
ordinary no-match uses the conversation and keeps search repair accessible
new message with a visible plan preserves its revision until explicit approval
follow-up compares exact previous displayed cards through actual owned HTTP context
ambiguous memory keeps exact cards and manual search clears continuation
loading a sample clears the previous discovery parent instead of relabelling its cards
a late completed discovery cannot attach its parent to replacement sample cards
accepting a newer manual diagnostic cancels and ignores an older completed AI result
a dropped polling read recovers the same typed reply preview with exactly one turn POST
persistent polling transport loss stops after three retries and never creates another turn
cancel during a polling retry prevents a completed stale result from returning
turn creation transport loss is not retried and does not start polling
budget recovery proposes minimum increase and only applies after acceptance
location chooser selects a recorded address point without silently applying mission
startup rate limit offers explicit successful retry
late new mission never steals a later product checkbox focus
comparison aligns source facts and shows same-condition seller feasibility
empty literal search explains a budget mismatch and recovers only on selection
contact-only discovery leads to a real supplied website route without a synthetic phone
radius recovery only changes radius and retains the chosen origin and budget
global comparison prices never reuse contact-filtered search prices
comparison failure is unknown rather than zero and retries the unchanged snapshot
planned visits default to declared hours and an explicit opt-out persists
stale recovery refreshes current plan without autoaccepting or discarding draft edits
pending sample load cannot overwrite a later manual budget edit
late condition save preserves a newer selected origin as an uncommitted draft
late sample loading preserves a newer origin separately from its sample mission
real demo recovery preserves mission and price arithmetic
search fields work and mobile does not overflow
reply dialog keeps keyboard focus and returns to the repaired plan
cancel during initial AI request prevents a late answer from replacing search
clipboard denial is explained inside the reply dialog
unanswered sellers can be rechecked after all options are exhausted
late saved-mission restore cannot replace a new choice (success)
